$comment: Hot-path index for PR review. Consumed by tools/hot-paths/detect.sh and documented by the `hot-paths` skill. Tiers are ordered by call frequency: a change in tier 1 runs per datum (up to 1M), tier 4 runs once per bundle load.

tiers.frequency: once per datum, per SERIES_UPDATE — up to 1e6 iterations
invariants: TypedArrays (Float64Array/Uint32Array/Int32Array) are reused across renders, not reallocated — reuse arrays are threaded through helper signatures
Two-pass count-then-fill so the second pass can write into a reused array
Scratch objects are pre-allocated outside the loop and mutated in place
No closure, array, object or template-string allocation inside the loop body
Per-datum callbacks (getDatumId, label formatting) are gated on whether their result is used
Positional parameters, not destructuring, on per-datum helpers

tiers.frequency: once per animation frame, per node — 60Hz x node count
invariants: @DeclaredSceneChangeDetection with a matching `declare __field`, and render paths read the backing field
Batched writes via setStyleProperties()/setStaticProperties() collapse to a single markDirty()
resetDatumAnimation() overrides bypass resetMotion()'s per-datum callback
Returned anchors/boxes are frozen shared literals or caller-owned `out` params, never fresh objects
BBox and matrix values are updated in place

tiers.frequency: once per pointer move, data transaction, or chart update
invariants: The narrowest sufficient ChartUpdateType is requested — never FULL where PERFORM_LAYOUT or SERIES_UPDATE suffices
Incremental paths keyed off processedData.changeDescription are preserved, not degraded to a full rescan
DOM writes go through DOMElementProxy's compare-before-write surface; layout-triggering reads are cached and invalidated by listener
Tick and domain computation is memoised or gated, not recomputed per update

tiers.frequency: once per bundle load — governed by size-limit budgets
invariants: New code reachable from main.ts stays inside the src/dist budgets in the package's .size-limit.js
Module registration stays lazy — no eager import of a feature the entry point does not need

signals.$comment: Stage-2 narrowing. A tier-1/2/3 file hit alone is not enough to warrant the analysis pass; an added line must also carry one of these.

markerComments.$comment: Existing in-code tripwires. A hunk landing within `proximityLines` of one of these is the highest-precision signal available and needs no maintained symbol list.

evidence.benchmarkBase: merge-base of the PR branch, not the base-branch tip
evidence.noiseFilters: compare-browser-results.js requires a change to clear --min-pct, --min-abs-ms, and NOISE_BAND_FACTOR x cross-run CV before it counts as a regression

signalWeights.$comment: Stage-2 scoring. A group scores its weight when matched in an added line, half (floor, minimum 1) when only in surrounding context. markerWeight applies when a change lands within markerComments.proximityLines of an existing hot-path marker; loopWeight when an added line executes inside a loop. A file triggers at `threshold`; the PR triggers on its highest-scoring file. Calibrated at threshold 3 over the last 48 PR merges: stage 1 (tier globs alone) matches 67% of them, scoring narrows that to 27%, and 10 of 13 known performance commits are caught. See the `hot-paths` skill.
